rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Agent Workspace provides a secure, containerized sandbox where AI agents can autonomously write, test, and execute code. It offers a full project lifecycle with uv for Python dependency management, bash execution with mandatory timeouts, filesystem operations with path-traversal protection, multi-layer security (non-root execution, read-only root filesystem), and atomic file editing with syntax validation for Python, JSON, and TOML. Real-time logging and audit capabilities are included. Designed to prevent AI-driven code execution from affecting the host system.
